task.title: Enforce residual issue coverage in gateway pass policy
task.summary: Add machine enforcement so close/promotion gates block when actionable lint/audit/graph drift remains without durable residual issue coverage.

goal.outcome: Gateway preflight/report pass policy detects uncovered actionable residual drift and blocks closure/promotion until coverage is fixed, owned, deferred, archived, compatible, or marked false-positive with evidence.
acceptance: Defines residual issue coverage shape with stable issue key, classification, refs, rationale, and optional trigger/expiry.
Gate preflight/report computes uncovered residual drift from current lint/audit/graph evidence.
Pass verdict is forced to block when uncovered actionable residual drift remains for close/promotion gates.
Covered warnings do not block when backed by open task, active sprint, accepted deferral, archive candidate, accepted compatibility, or false-positive evidence.
Regression tests cover uncovered warning block, open-task coverage pass, accepted deferral pass, and audit-warning evidence not being treated as clean pass evidence.
non_goals: Do not require global zero warnings.
Do not archive or delete legacy artifacts.
Do not solve every current warning class in this task.

delta.desired:
Additional outcome: System knowledge clearly states that actionable residual drift cannot be orphaned and explains how trace audits should expose closure residuals.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Prompt asset paths have explicit file-structure ownership and no longer appear as ambiguous adapter/skill drift.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Current test paths are accepted compatibility surfaces, mapped shared/task roots, or migrated in scoped batches with validation.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Legacy rowless decision-build warnings have explicit residual coverage/deferral or a validated archive/trace-catalog plan with restore evidence requirements.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Low-risk doc hygiene and compatibility export warning classes are fixed or explicitly covered after priority ownership/gate tasks are in place.
